question: Do you have a written quality policy in your enterprise?
Have you appointed a quality champion or ZED coordinator?
Is your workplace free of unnecessary items and clutter?
Do tools and materials have fixed, labelled storage locations?
Is there a regular cleaning schedule followed by workers?
Do you maintain inspection records for finished products?
Do you have a process to record and resolve customer complaints?
Are your production processes documented with work instructions?
Do you track on-time delivery performance?
Have you done any customer satisfaction survey in the last year?
Have you identified the main sources of waste in your production process?
Have you taken any steps to reduce material wastage or rework?
Do you record monthly electricity and fuel consumption?
Do you have a proper waste disposal process (solid and liquid)?
Do workers use required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)?
Are fire safety equipment and emergency exits clearly marked?
Do you use any digital tool for accounts, billing, or inventory?
Do you accept digital payments (UPI, NEFT, etc.)?
Are you a member of any industry or trade association?
Do you comply with applicable labour laws (wages, working hours)?
